business_goal: An HLS playlist and its segments register as ONE asset with a real, registry-native byte total; the registry is version-tagged (a pre-v2 registry is discarded wholesale and its orphans swept once); eviction removes the whole asset atomically without ever rescanning disk; every playlist/segment request always terminates with a response (R2/R3/R6/R9/R10, A2/A3, UC-IngestHlsPlaylist + UC-IngestHlsSegment + UC-EvictCacheAsset, breadboard slices V2+V3).
